objective: Obtain comparable boundary, performance, Retrieval, and quality evidence at one declared context for the applicable dual-GPU DeepSeek configuration.

coverage_decisions.single_gpu: Not selected: prior single-GPU boundary attempts are inconclusive; capability is not inferred or silently declared inapplicable.
coverage_decisions.dual_gpu: Selected: Vulkan0,Vulkan1 with -sm layer and -ts 1,1; tensor/row split excluded by target Vulkan testbed limitation.
coverage_decisions.context: One same-context publication candidate at 1024; upstream 131072 is not treated as local capacity evidence.
coverage_decisions.kv: Default f16 K/V baseline only; no blind KV sweep.

stop_rule: Stop at the first unexpected result; preserve the terminal classification and do not retry blindly.

publication.requirement: All publication metrics must be measured at declared context 1024; no mixed-context evidence may be promoted.
